description: Land  Acquisition - Pathegama Central, Walasgala and Babaranda Central, Dickwella D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes (railway department use), including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, lot numbers, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or electoral matters.
